name: Asheville East KOA Holiday
note: KOA Holiday at 2708 Highway 70 East, Swannanoa; full-hookup RV sites, pull-throughs. RV sites $40-80 a night before tax for a mid-May 2027 weeknight on KOA's booking form. Reopened in October 2025 after Hurricane Helene flood damage, front of the property first; the back half is still being rebuilt (2025 reports). RV Life 4.5*, $$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: KOA booking form (koa.com/campgrounds/asheville-east/reserve/) quoted 2027-05-18, 1 night, 23-ft motorhome: RV site types $40-80 before tax (read 2026-10-19); RV Life 4.5* over 372 reviews, 175 sites
wf: satellite (Esri, sat.py) read 2026-10-19: imagery shows the property scoured by the 2024 Hurricane Helene flood, before the rebuild; the Swannanoa River crosses the middle of it and KOA now sells 'Riverside' types, but the rebuilt pads cannot be placed from this imagery; not waterfront pending newer imagery
